description: Runic Skills is a mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) based on the Just Leveling mod - it adds stats, skills and more to the game.

mods.name: Runic Skills
mods.description: Runic Skills adds a deep RPG progression system: level up ten Aptitudes (Strength, Constitution, Dexterity, Endurance, Fortune, Intelligence, Building, Magic, Wisdom, Tinkering), unlock hundreds of Perks, Passives, Powers and Titles, and gate items behind skill requirements. Ships broad optional integrations with magic, gun, and combat mods.

mods.name: Runic Skills — T.O. Companion
mods.description: Optional Runic Skills integration for the verified T.O. Magic 'n Extras profile. Contains no upstream mod code.

releases.notes:
Icon refresh for Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge 47.x. Network protocol **18**, unchanged from 2.2.1, requires matching client and server builds. Progression IDs, saved configuration and existing worlds are unaffected.

This is the first published build to carry the 2.1.2, 2.2.0 and 2.2.1 changes, none of which shipped separately. Read those entries in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/otectus/runic-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) before upgrading a live world; in particular, 2.2.1's automatic gates are on by default and can add requirements to previously ungated content. Preview them with `/skills locks preview` and `/skills locks coverage`, or set `enableAutoGates = false`.

## Changes in 2.2.2

- Every icon is replaced: the 586 perk, passive and skill-rank icons and all 111 Power icons are redrawn as shaded full-colour art at the same 16×16 size and file names, so no model, atlas, registration or datapack change is involved.
- The icon catalogue is pinned to the shipped art and `RunicIconIntegrityTest` is updated for the new style; the limited-palette rule and the 250-opaque-pixel cutoff are gone, while size, binary alpha, uniqueness and the pinned pixel hash are still enforced.

## Which file to install

- `runicskills-2.2.2.jar` — **install this one.** It bundles MixinExtras, which Forge does not ship.
- `runicskills-2.2.2-slim.jar` — the same mod without the bundled dependency, for packs that already provide MixinExtras 0.4.0.
- `runicskills-tom-compat-2.2.2.jar` — optional T.O. companion for Aqua Attunement; install only alongside the pinned T.O. and Iron's Spellbooks versions (see the T.O. companion guide in `docs/integrations/`).

Consolidated post-1.0.0 release. Bundles the Botania integration (originally 1.0.1), the magic-tree cross-mod expansion (originally 1.0.2), the dedicated-server YACL safety refactor that the README has been advertising since 1.0.1 was actually fixed, the L2Tabs class-load fix, and triage of three CurseForge user reports. **120 new perks across five mod integrations** plus a real capability change â€” the mod now actually runs on dedicated servers without YACL installed.

## Headline fixes

- **Dedicated server now genuinely works without YACL.** The README has been claiming this since 1.0.1 but the code crashed at boot with `NoClassDefFoundError: dev/isxander/yacl3/...`. New `ConfigHolder<T>` wraps persistence with plain Gson; YACL UI moves behind a client-only builder reached via reflection. `mods.toml` flips YACL to `mandatory=false`. New build lint forbids YACL executable-class imports outside `client/config/`.
- **L2Tabs no-mod boot crash fixed.** Same JVM-verifier eager-resolution shape that 1.0.0 fixed for Legendary Tabs but missed for L2Tabs. Extracted to `L2TabsClientIntegration::registerTab` method reference.
- **Three CurseForge reports addressed:** `/globallimit` now works in-game; the Scholar perk no longer hides every enchantment in the world when added to `disabledPerks`; `disabledPerks` and `disabledPassives` now appear in the YACL config UI.

## New content (120 perks)

- **Botania (42 perks)** â€” full Wisdom + Magic perk tree across rune / season / sin / Gaia progression. 18 with effects shipping in 1.1.0; 24 default-disabled pending future implementation. Optional integration; class-load-isolated.
- **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (46 perks)** â€” 16 generic mana/casting (Wellspring, Mana Bulwark, Charge Mastery, â€¦), 28 school specialists (X-mancer / X-Warded / X-Catalyst across 9 schools + Eldritch Attunement), 2 summon perks (Lord of the Dead, Life Leech Bound).
- **Apotheosis + Apothic Attributes (12 perks)** â€” Socket Virtuoso, Affix Affinity, plus 10 stat-stick perks against `ALObjects.Attributes.*`.
- **Ars Nouveau (11 perks)** â€” 4 form/utility (Form Focus triad, Wild Manipulation), 7 per-school (Hedgewitch, Emberforged, Stormcaller, Geomancer, Conjurer, Abjurer, Arcane Weaver).
- **Cross-mod synergy (9 perks)** â€” 6 Schoolbridges (ISS + Ars), Unified Arcana, Triple Threat, Affix Focus.

## Other changes

- **Charge Mastery has a real effect**: ISS 3.x has no `CastType.CHARGE`, so the perk treats `CastType.LONG` as the held-cast equivalent and applies a configurable `chargeMasteryPercent` damage bonus (default `+25%`). Stacks multiplicatively with Long Channel.
- **Per-integration "Generated N lock items" log lines** demoted from INFO to DEBUG.
- **Network protocol bumped 3 â†’ 5** â€” old 1.0.x clients hitting a 1.1.0 server (and vice versa) get a clean connection refusal.
- **Save-compatible with 1.0.0** â€” no NBT changes. Existing JSON5 config files load cleanly.

## Documentation

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/otectus/runic-skills/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md), [COMMENT_TRIAGE.md](https://github.com/otectus/runic-skills/blob/master/COMMENT_TRIAGE.md), and [docs/SMOKE_TESTS.md](https://github.com/otectus/runic-skills/blob/master/docs/SMOKE_TESTS.md) for full per-fix detail and the regression checklist.

## Install

Drop `runicskills-1.1.0.jar` into `mods/` on Forge 47.3.0+ for Minecraft 1.20.1. YACL 3.4.2+ is recommended client-side for the in-game config UI but is not required (server-side or otherwise).
